_README: Q115: descending_thoracic_aorta-only reconversion of vhf_total.nii.gz label 52
(aorta, split by aorta_by_vertebral_level), at --smooth 0.0 instead of ct_vhf's
own 1.0. Raw source main_frac for this label is 1.000 (ONE piece) but the
shipped descending_thoracic_aorta measured 0.711 -- smoothing was the destroyer.
Only 'descending_thoracic' is mapped (to descending_thoracic_aorta); arch and
abdominal are left null so this subject claims ONLY that one atlas_id, leaving
subject: ct_vhf_descaorta
